post.title: Over 21% of the S&P 500 Is Now Just Three Stocks
post.ig:
Over 21% of the S&P 500 is just three stocks.
Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft now make up more than 21% of the index, the most ever for three stocks (Creative Planning data, Oct 6, 2026).
The old record: IBM, AT&T and Exxon at 13.4% in the mid-1980s.
Most S&P 500 funds are weighted by company size. In SPY: Nvidia 8.63%, Apple 7.25%, Microsoft 5.82%. Equal-weight versions give each company about 0.2%.
Sources: Yahoo Finance, Creative Planning, Benzinga.
